summary: One tab of a tab list. Selecting it shows its panel.

value.description: Pairs the tab with the panel of the same value. Without it the tab's position is its value.

selected.description: This is the selected tab. The tabs element keeps one tab selected; a script that sets it selects the tab.

disabled.description: The tab cannot be selected or focused.

root.note: No face at rest. selected: layer base, relief raised, face neutral, never the solid face.

keys.Enter: Selects the tab at key down, when activation is manual.
keys.Space: Selects the tab at key up, when activation is manual.

notYet: A disabled tab still dispatches click to a listener the author adds; the tabs element ignores it.
